themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including web research, data analysis, and complex problem-solving.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that aid in writing, reviewing, debugging, and analyzing code, enhancing developer productivity.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: This theme covers a broad range of AI tools designed to facilitate and enhance various aspects of scientific and market research.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions on the use of simulated users or data generated by AI for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles exploring the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots in various contexts, including user interaction and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being used to assist in the design process, including interface design, experience design, and generating design concepts.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the features, performance, and effectiveness of different AI tools for research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content examining how AI is changing job roles, creating new opportunities, and potentially displacing existing jobs across various industries.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in information processing.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications aimed at understanding customer behavior, preferences, and feedback to inform business strategies.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
